title: Daily Digest B: Freshman of the Week sweep (Tue Nov 24)
parts:
🏆 DEVYDOSE DAILY BUZZ | Tue, Nov 24

Monday's conference honors were a freshman showcase: two 5-star QBs took Freshman of the Week in the SEC and Big 12, and first-year backs took the Big Ten and ACC rookie honors 🧵👇

🏅 FAIZON BRANDON | Tennessee | FR, 5⭐ | #29 QB (preseason: #52)

SEC Freshman of the Week, his fourth. Ties a Tennessee record (via WIVK).

🏅 KEISEAN HENDERSON | Houston | FR, 5⭐ | #20 QB

Big 12 Freshman of the Week after his first start (via BVM Sports).

🏅 BRANDON SMITH | Oregon | FR | #183 RB (preseason: #398)

Big Ten Freshman of the Week: 121 yards, 2 TDs at Michigan State (via Big Ten).

🏅 DEUCE LAWRENCE | Wake Forest | FR, 3⭐ | #143 RB (preseason: #274)

ACC Rookie of the Week (via Augusta Free Press).

🔥 COLE TABB | Cincinnati | JR, 3⭐ | #84 RB (preseason: #217)

Big 12 Offensive Player of the Week again: 230 scrimmage yards, 4 TDs vs Colorado (via Cincinnati Enquirer).

Big Ten's pick: Anthony Colandrea | Nebraska | SR, 3⭐ | #22 QB.

Which freshman do you want? 👇
